actions.rationale: Sidecar open_positions is empty, so OPEN rather than HOLD/ADD. Receive the locked AONIA IB 2027-03/06 strip where ~51-59bp of extra tightening remains priced after housing/labor evidence. Size 55m of the 100m gross cap: enough to clear the 3.85% SOFR funding vig, below full cap because AU inflation score 82, energy overlay, and mixed 2022 hiking-cycle analogs can still reprice the strip higher.

events.invalidation: RBA delivers or IB fully prices the remaining 50-60bp of tightening while housing/labor stop deteriorating.
events.rationale: FACT: Housing turnover and prices are already contracting under current AONIA 4.35, AU employment fell 15.8k, unemployment rose to 4.5%, September consumer sentiment fell 5.2% to 84.4, and IB still prices a 4.94 area 2027 H1 terminal (~59bp over cash). INFERENCE: that residual hike path is a policy error into a housing bust and will be cut as labor/housing data stay weak; receiving the 2027 H1 AONIA strip is the cleanest slowdown expression. UNKNOWN: whether trimmed-mean 3.6%, the energy shock, or one more RBA hike lands before the housing channel dominates. Sidecar open_positions is empty, so this is a new OPEN versus the $100m cap, not an add to an existing IB position.
